main_text.l: pendetur, Job.6.2. Niph. Praeter. נִשְׁקַל Appensum est argentum, Esr.8.33. Futur. יִשְׁקַל ut paulo ante.

שֶׁקֶל m. Siclus, moneta argentea, pondere, ut hodie adhuc vifitur, dimidio Joachimico sive Imperiali respondens: & hic dictus fuit Siclus sacer, viginti Geras continens, Exod. 30.13. Gera sive Obolus pendebat sedecim grana hordeacea. Siclus communis quadrantem taleri valuit. Plur. שְׁקָלִים Sicli, Exod.21.32.
מִשְׁקָל m. Pondus, Ezech.5.1. Conftr. מִשְׁקַל הַזָּהָב Pondus auri, 1.Reg.10.14. Aff. מִשְׁקָלוֹ Pondus ejus, Gen.24.22. מִשְׁקוֹל m. Idem, Ezech.4.10.
שִׁקְמִים m.p. Sycomori, arbores, Jes.9.10. Pro fructu, Amos 7.14. Foemin. cum Aff. וּשְׁקְמוֹתָם Et sycomoros ipsorum, Psal.78.47.

שָׁקַע Submergi, In profundum deprimi, Compprimi, Reprimi: Praeterir. וַיִּשְׁקַע Atq; submergitur, Amos 9.5. Futur. תִּשְׁקַע Submergetur, Jer.51. v.64. Niph. Praeter. וְנִשְׁקַע [?] Et submergetur, Amos 8.8, sic scribitur absque ע, sed legendum juxta Masforethas וְנִשְׁקָעָה. Hiph. Futur. אַשְׁקִיעַ מַיִם Faciam ut profundum petant, id est, limpida fiant, subsidant aquae illarum, Ezech.32.14. תַּשְׁקִיעַ לְשׁוֹנוֹ Demerges linguam illius, Job.40.20.

מִשְׁקַע m. Sedimentū, quod subsidit: Conft. וּמִשְׁקַע־מַיִם תִּשְׁתּוּ Et sedimentum aquarum bibetis, Ezech.34. v.18. per hypallagen, pro Aquas sedimenti, id est, puras, limpidas, in quibus omnis crassa aut terrea materia subsidet, & in profundum depressa est.
שִׁקְעֻרוּרוֹת f.p. Fossulae, Profunditates fossae, Lev.14. verf.37. Quidam compositum censent ex שָׁקַע & שָׁרוּר sive

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing is approximate and the forms marked [?] are doubtful (the Niph. Praeter. form וְנִשְׁקַע at Amos 8.8, and the compound at the end of the page). The section letters ש in the left margin are shown as notes beside their entries. The entry ש־ע־ר (שָׁרוּר) at the foot is only partly legible. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Jes."), per the printed "Jef"/"Jefa".
